events.description:
AI Odyssey is an international hackathon organized in collaboration with GDG FST and Dione Protocol. Over 7 days, students and young professionals work on projects related to AI, data, finance, and sustainability.

The event included workshops, technical mentoring, an in-person evaluation, and a final pitch.

It aimed to foster innovation, connect talents with international tech players, and promote high-impact technological solutions.
highlights: workshops: An online workshop everyday to prepare participants for the D day
Networking: Participants had the opportunity to connect with professionals and peers
Career Talks: Panel discussions with senior professionals sharing insights on career development
Prizes and Giveaways: Exciting prizes for participants and winners of contests
outcomes: Positive feedback from 95% of participating companies
Strong media coverage and social media engagement
Established partnerships with key industry players for future collaborations

events.title: Reset and Rise
events.excerpt:
Organized by JCI TBS El Mourouj in collaboration with JCI Curepipe
In today's fast-paced world, prioritizing mental well-being is more important than ever. Reset and Rise is a powerful two-part online event designed to help you pause, reflect, and come back mentally and emotionally stronger🧘‍♀️🧠
